title: The Inter-rater Reliability of the Turkish Version of Aphasia Rapid Test for Stroke
brief_summary: The Aphasia Rapid Test (ART) is a bedside aphasia screening test developed originally in French. The purpose of this study is to assess the inter-rater reliability of the Turkish version of the ART in stroke patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Left MCA infarct due to CVA
* Right hand dominant
* Turkish as first language
* CVA within the last 10 days

Exclusion Criteria:

* Right or bilateral brain lesion
* Previous stroke
* Psychiatric disorder
* Other neurological disorder
* Cognitive impairment
* Endotracheal entubation prohibiting responses to test
study_population: The study population will consist of left MCA stroke patients who experienced a CVA within the last 10 days. These patients will consist of males and females with a minimum age of 18.
